nl_query: List each player's name, nationality, and age with their team name and team location.

query_text:
SELECT player.name, player.position, team.team_name, team.founded_year
FROM player
JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name
WHERE player.age > 25;
nl_query: For players older than 25, list player name, position, team name, and team founded year.

query_text:
SELECT player.name, player.draft_pick, player.college, team.team_name
FROM player
JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name
WHERE player.draft_pick >= 0;
nl_query: For players with draft pick at least 0, list player name, draft pick, college, and team name.
List team name and location with the matched city name and state name.

query_text:
SELECT player.name, team.team_name, city.city_name, city.state_name
FROM player
JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name
JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name;
nl_query: List player name with team name, city name, and city state by linking player -> team -> city.

query_text:
SELECT player.name, player.position, city.city_name, city.population
FROM player
JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name
JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name
WHERE player.age < 35;
nl_query: For players younger than 35, list player name, position, city name, and city population via player -> team -> city.

query_text:
SELECT player.name, player.college, team.team_name, city.gdp
FROM player
JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name
JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name
WHERE player.draft_pick > 0;
nl_query: For players with draft pick greater than 0, list player name, college, team name, and city GDP via player -> team -> city.

query_text:
SELECT player.name, player.birth_date, team.team_name, city.area
FROM player
JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name
JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name
WHERE city.area > 100;
nl_query: For cities with area greater than 100, list player name, player birth date, team name, and city area via player -> team -> city.

query_text:
SELECT city.city_name, city.state_name, team.team_name, player.name
FROM city
JOIN team ON city.city_name = team.location
JOIN player ON player.team = team.team_name
WHERE player.age < 40;
nl_query: Starting from city and traversing city -> team -> player, list city name, state, team name, and player name for players younger than 40.

query_text:
SELECT city.city_name, city.state_name, team.team_name, player.name, player.college
FROM city
JOIN team ON city.city_name = team.location
JOIN player ON player.team = team.team_name
WHERE player.age > 20;
nl_query: Starting from city and traversing city -> team -> player, list city name, state, team name, player name, and player college for players older than 20.
